title: Survey and level the supports; all hot work now: convert the old door to W1, seal end B, cut the AC sleeve
note: Survey sheet first: nothing is cut before study/studio/survey.csv is complete. No welding or grinding on the shell after the spray foam (S05).

title: Prime the steel; lay the membrane over the treated floor; screw down the floor sheets
note: Never sand the treated container floor. Sheets 2440 x 1220, long side along the box, joints staggered by half a sheet, 3 mm gaps, a screw every 300 mm both ways.

title: Fix the battens: one under every lining-panel joint and edge, infill at 600 mm or less
note: Winged screws into the steel at both ends and every 600 mm along each batten.

title: Services first fix: earth rod, conduits and cables in the batten cavities, pipes in the floor void; pressure-test the pipes at 10 bar before the foam
note: HOLD before S05: licensed electrician and plumber on site; the test is recorded.

title: Spray foam between the battens, let it cure and trim it flush; fix the numbered lining panels (cut-outs already in place)
note: HOLD: the S04 pressure test has passed. No welding or grinding on the shell once the foam is in.

title: Stand the partition frame and fix its skins, leaving the door opening by the front wall
Fit the door frame, fix the track inside the bathroom on the partition and hang the sliding door
Cement board, membrane and tiles on the wet walls; coved vinyl floor
Set the shower tray and the fixed screen
Hang the WC, the instant heater in the shower and its hand-shower rail
Lay the oak planks over the living area (end A to the partition); then assemble the fridge bay, hob base and sink base on their legs along the partition
Assemble the two wall cabinets and hang them on the steel rail, either side of the hob
note: Lift each cabinet up: two people.

title: Scribe and fix the worktop; drop in the sink and hob; plinth
Hang the chimney hood on the partition between the wall cabinets, 650 mm over the hob, and fix its chimney cover up to the ceiling
Fix the headboard to the back wall; bolt the frame; screw down the slats; slide in the storage boxes
Glue the leg strips; screw the top and the shelf; set the table by the bed head
Place the sofa; slot together the table and the two chairs
Scribe and pin the trims; caulk and paint
Second fix: unit board, devices, lights, alarms; test and certify
note: Certificate from a RURA class A electrician before power-on.

title: Lift and bolt the deck beams onto the corner castings; joists
Screw down the deck boards (5 mm gaps)
Bolt the guardrail posts to the deck beams
Fix the hardwood top rail; thread and tension the stainless cables
Veranda posts, ledger, polycarbonate and gutter over the front deck
Set the stair footings; bolt the two flights and the landing
Place the chairs and the side table
Bond the steelwork to earth; engineer's inspection before guest use
